Overview of Both Tools

ezyVet

ezyVet is a cloud-based veterinary practice management platform founded in 2006 and headquartered in Auckland, New Zealand (now part of IDEXX). Marketed as "cloud-based veterinary practice management solution", it serves 15,000+ clinics worldwide and is best suited for large hospitals, specialty/referral clinics, multi-location enterprises. The platform supports Small animal, Large animal, Specialty, Emergency, Multi-location practice types.

Vetspire

Vetspire is a cloud-based veterinary software solution founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. Described as "innovative pims for clinical decision-making", it serves growing specialty market and is best suited for specialty clinics, teaching hospitals, data-driven practices. It supports Small animal, Specialty, Emergency, Teaching hospital practice types.

Feature-by-Feature Comparison

We evaluated ezyVet and Vetspire across six key areas that matter most to veterinary practices.

Clinical Features / EMR

Vetspire wins

Vetspire was originally built for teaching hospitals and includes clinical decision support tools that help veterinarians during the diagnostic process. ezyVet provides a comprehensive EMR with highly customizable workflows. Both are powerful, but Vetspire's clinical decision support is a unique differentiator for specialty and academic settings.

Scheduling & Booking

ezyVet wins

ezyVet offers advanced scheduling with resource management suited for multi-doctor, multi-location hospitals. Vetspire includes appointment scheduling but focuses more on clinical workflow efficiency. For complex scheduling needs, ezyVet has the advantage.

Client Communication

Tie

ezyVet provides automated communications and a client portal. Vetspire includes referral management, which is critical for specialty clinics that receive cases from general practitioners. Neither platform is a standout in client communication compared to dedicated tools like PetDesk.

Pricing & Value

ezyVet wins

ezyVet starts at $250/mo with custom pricing for larger setups. Vetspire starts at $349/mo per full-time veterinarian, making it the more expensive option. However, Vetspire does not require per-location pricing, which may benefit single-location specialty clinics. Neither offers a free trial or free plan.

Integrations

ezyVet wins

ezyVet benefits from deep IDEXX ownership integration with VetConnect PLUS, SmartFlow, and VetRadar, plus QuickBooks and Xero support. Vetspire integrates with IDEXX, Antech, and various imaging systems. ezyVet's integration ecosystem is broader and deeper.

Ease of Use

Vetspire wins

Vetspire is known for a fast, responsive interface that clinicians appreciate during busy shifts. ezyVet is powerful but has a steep learning curve and complex onboarding process. For practices that value speed and simplicity in daily use, Vetspire is the better experience.

Our Recommendation

We recommend ezyVet for large, multi-location enterprise practices that need maximum workflow customization and the deepest IDEXX integration available. We recommend Vetspire for specialty clinics, emergency hospitals, and teaching institutions where clinical decision support and fast charting during high-pressure cases are top priorities. Both are premium-priced platforms. If budget is a concern, consider alternatives like Digitail or Shepherd.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is ezyVet or Vetspire cheaper?

ezyVet starts at $250/mo with custom quotes for larger practices. Vetspire starts at $349/mo per full-time veterinarian. Both are premium-priced platforms. Neither offers a free plan, and only ezyVet offers a free trial.

Which is better for specialty clinics?

Vetspire was originally built for teaching hospitals and includes clinical decision support tools specifically designed for specialty and referral practices. ezyVet handles specialty workflows well through customization but was not purpose-built for that use case.

Do they offer free trials?

ezyVet offers a free trial. Vetspire does not currently offer a free trial. You will need to request a demo from the Vetspire team to evaluate the platform.

Which has better reporting and analytics?

Both offer strong reporting. ezyVet is known for its powerful, highly customizable reporting suite with detailed financial reports. Vetspire offers advanced analytics with a focus on clinical data insights. The choice depends on whether you prioritize financial reporting (ezyVet) or clinical analytics (Vetspire).
